description: For a scoped formula \(A\) with \(n\) available slots and no free-variable names, terms \(t_0,\ldots,t_{n-1}\) in \(k\) retained slots, and \(b\in M^k\), the simultaneous instance \(A[t_0,\ldots,t_{n-1}]\) is true at \(b\) if and only if \(A\) is true at the tuple of values \(\bigl(\llbracket t_i\rrbracket_b^M\bigr)_{i<n}\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Skolemization.Prenex.fill_realize.{w, u', v'} {M : Type w} {L' : FirstOrder.Language}
  [L'.Structure M] {n k : ℕ} (φ : L'.BoundedFormula Empty n) (ts : Fin n → L'.Term (Empty ⊕ Fin k)) (us : Fin k → M) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Skolemization.Prenex.fill φ ts).Realize Empty.elim us ↔
    φ.Realize Empty.elim fun i => FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize (Sum.elim Empty.elim us) (ts i)
